questions.q: What is a price list in Oracle Fusion Order Management?
options: A list of customers eligible to place orders
A list of items on credit hold
A defined set of prices for items, usually by currency and sometimes customer segment
A report of shipped orders
questions.explain: A price list defines item prices, typically segmented by currency and sometimes by customer group.

questions.q: Which of these is an example of an automatic discount?
options: A rule that applies 5% off whenever a line's quantity is 300 units or more
A salesperson typing a one-off 10% discount on a single line
An accountant adjusting a General Ledger balance
A customer requesting a refund
questions.explain: An automatic discount fires on its own whenever an order meets a predefined condition, like a quantity threshold.

questions.q: How was SO-48217's net total of $55,100.00 calculated?
options: A manually negotiated flat rate with no connection to the price list
$58,000.00 list total plus a $2,900.00 shipping fee
400 units multiplied directly by $137.75
$58,000.00 list total minus a $2,900.00 (5%) automatic volume discount
questions.explain: The $145.00 list price times 400 units gives $58,000.00; the automatic 5% volume rule subtracts $2,900.00, leaving $55,100.00.

questions.q: What typically has to happen when someone wants to apply a discount beyond what standard pricing rules allow?
options: Nothing — any discount can be applied freely
It usually must route through an approval rule before the order can proceed
The order is automatically cancelled
The customer's account is closed
questions.explain: Discounts outside standard, pre-approved rules typically require routing through an approval process, often built with AME.

questions.q: What is the key difference between a price override approval and a credit check?
options: They are the same thing
A credit check only applies to new items
A price override approval asks if a discount is allowed; a credit check asks if the customer can afford the order
A price override only applies to returns
questions.explain: Price override approval governs whether a non-standard discount is permitted; credit check governs the customer's financial exposure.
